column1: # The languages this repository ships, in order.
# This file is the metadata the old catalog could not carry: which language a message is written in
# was inferred by sniffing the key for Han characters (internal/i18n/i18n.go:220-237), which is how an
# English-source message came to render its Chinese value under QK_LANG=en (6a37193) and how 105
# translations became unreachable under QK_LANG=zh (43bbff6). Direction is data here, never a guess.
#   lang   the code used by QK_LANG / the catalog
#   dir    "source" for the one language messages are written in, "translation" for the rest
# Exactly one language must be marked source, and it is the language of the text in every
# messages.tsv row. The generator fails the build otherwise.
